name: timr
description:
timr connects Claude to your timr time-tracking account (timr.com) so you can manage your work hours in plain language instead of clicking through the app.

Ask things like "what am I working on right now?", "log 30 minutes on the Acme project", "stop my working time", or "show my project time
for last Friday", and Claude handles it for you.

Key features:
• Working times — start, stop, add, edit, and delete your clock-in/clock-out records
• Project time — track time against specific projects and tasks
• Drive logs — record business trips with cars and categories for your mileage log
• Absences — create and manage multi-day date spans for vacation, sick leave, and training
• Live status — instantly see what timers are currently running
• Balances — check your working-time, overtime, surcharge, and vacation account totals

The connector is a stateless, secure passthrough to the timr API. It authenticates each user individually via OAuth 2.1 (PKCE), never
stores your credentials, and only ever acts on your own timr data.

Requires a timr account. Learn more at https://timr.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add timr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add timr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.timr.app/mcp.

acceptedAnswer.text: timr lists 27 MCP tools, including add_drive_log, add_project_time, add_working_time, create_working_time_date_span, delete_project_time, delete_working_time, delete_working_time_date_span, list_cars, list_drive_log_categories, list_drive_logs, list_project_times, and list_tasks.
